sentences.text: Date : 09.06.2025 [M. Choudhury, J] Heard Mr. K.P. Pathak, learned Amicus Curiae for the appellant and Ms. Page No.# 2/3 S.H. Borah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent no. 1, State of Assam.

2. This criminal appeal under Section 415[2] of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 is preferred against a Judgment and Order dated 22.01.2025 passed by the Court of learned Special Judge [POCSO], Tinsukia in POCSO Case no. 70/2022, arising out of Saikhowaghat Police Station Case no. 57/2021.

By the Judgment and Order dated 22.01.2025, the accused-appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376[2][f] of the Indian Penal Code and he has been sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/-.
3. We have gone through the contents of the memorandum of appeal.
4. The criminal appeal is admitted for hearing.
5. The case records of POCSO Case no. 70/2022 be called for.
As Ms. Bora, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1, issuance of formal notice to the respondent no. 1 is dispensed with.

However,
an extra copy of the memo of appeal along with annexures, is to be furnished to Ms. Borah within 3 [three] working days from today.
8. The appellant shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 by registered post with A/D within 3 [three] working days from today.
The name of Mr. K.P. Pathak, learned Amicus Curiae is to be reflected in the Cause-List.
